svg.title: Chains and estates: two estates share a private chain, a third stands on a public one; authority stays on its chain, evidence and value cross

g.text: shared by A and B by construction
one address per resident, in both estates
a grant verified by either runtime
a revocation seen by both, next block
roots of A, B and C
other chain: a Base grant, parked at Home A
a grant is signed into an EIP-712 domain
with the chain id and the DelegationManager;
on another chain it means nothing.
An act in C runs under a grant issued
Evidence crosses as a root or an anchor
A’s live-grant and membership roots on
public ground; a presentation reveals one leaf;
C’s edge reads the root it anchored, never
the proof in hand. A receipt cites the chain
and the anchor it was written to.
Value crosses under a bound mandate
a treasury moves funds through a bridge
mandate bound to the destination chain;
the bridge is outside Ring 0 and is never
the reason a payment was allowed.
LIVE · two estates on one chain
DESIGNED · roots on a public chain · cross-chain admission
PROPOSED · one principal with accounts on two chains, bound
A chain is ground, not a building. An estate enforces on one; several estates may stand on it; none of them is it.
